title: The Canon of the Deluge of Life
summary: A canon of Life at its greatest scale that calls back the fallen and cleanses whole hosts and ends in a flood of renewal.

title: The Codex of Overflowing Vitality
summary: A codex of vitality pushed past the limit of the body that restores armies and breaks enemies with the same overflow.

title: The Divine Book of Unending Renewal
summary: A divine book of renewal without end that raises the fallen in great numbers and heals what the world itself has wounded.
